subject.title: feat: prefer token-free transports before metered API quota

question: Should Octopool make token-free transports the unconditional default for all eligible multi-candidate routes, rather than using the prior anonymous-quota threshold?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes core request-selection policy and operational tradeoffs; tests can confirm ordering but cannot decide the intended production default.

options.title: Approve token-free-first policy
options.body: Adopt the new default after reviewing live evidence that supported parsers and same-cycle fallbacks behave correctly under representative traffic.

options.title: Retain quota-gated preference
options.body: Keep the existing threshold-based policy if reducing public-page dependency and extra first-hop latency is preferred over conserving anonymous quota.

recommendation.title: Approve token-free-first policy
recommendation.body: Adopt the new default after reviewing live evidence that supported parsers and same-cycle fallbacks behave correctly under representative traffic.
